evals.prompt: Build a ReAct-style agent that can search the web and answer factual questions, with a 10-step limit and cost tracking.
evals.expected_output: The agent implements a ReAct loop with observation-thought-action cycle, web search tool, step counter, and graceful termination.
expectations: ReAct loop with explicit thought-action-observation steps
Step limit of 10 enforced with graceful termination

evals.prompt: Add a file-writing tool to the agent that requires human approval before execution.
evals.expected_output: The agent registers a file-write tool classified as HIGH risk, with human-in-the-loop approval before execution.
expectations: File-write tool has typed schema with path and content arguments
Tool classified as HIGH risk per approval model
Human approval checkpoint fires before file write executes
